items.name: 20-year nuclear power purchase agreements with Meta
items.claim: Vistra today announced it has entered into 20-year PPAs to provide more than 2,600 megawatts of zero-carbon energy from a combination of three different Vistra nuclear plants to support Meta's operations in the region. The agreements include 2,176 MW of operating generation and an additional 433 MW of combined power output increases, which will be the largest nuclear uprates supported by a corporate customer in the United States.
items.source_excerpt: Vistra (NYSE: VST) today announced it has entered into 20-year PPAs to provide more than 2,600 megawatts of zero-carbon energy from a combination of three different Vistra nuclear plants to support Meta's operations in the region. The agreements include 2,176 MW of operating generation and an additional 433 MW of combined power output increases, which will be the largest nuclear uprates supported by a corporate customer in the United States .

notes: value 2600 MW is the total zero-carbon capacity figure ('more than 2,600 megawatts'); the excerpt also breaks it into 2,176 MW operating generation and 433 MW of uprates across Vistra's Beaver Valley, Davis-Besse, and Perry nuclear plants.
